market_view: Calm regime: VIX 15.8 (-23% in 5 days), Dow and S&P at records on a broad earnings beat. The late-July stress has reversed, with chips +13%, gold +6.7% and copper at a record in 5 days. Most of the rebound is already in prices.

oil_gas.reasoning: WTI fell 10.9% in 5 days to 75 on Hormuz reopening hopes; that move is priced in and the direction of a deal is unclear. XOM is down 3% in 5 days with no company-specific catalyst. No named reason for a long.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold jumped 3.7% in one day and NEM rose 6.7%, 14% in 5 days; that is priced in, and no cause is visible in the headlines. Gold is still 19% below its peak with 10-year yields at 4.6%. Chasing the spike is not a reason.

chips.reasoning: The sector rebounded 13% in 5 days and NVDA is up 15%; the rebound already happened. No NVDA earnings date or new catalyst is in the record. AMD fell 7% despite strong results, which shows how fragile the mood is. Stay out.

pharma.reasoning: Lilly reported Q2 and raised guidance, the catalyst I was watching. LLY rose 4.9% on the day, so the surprise is priced in. It is still 5% below its high after +23% in 60 days. No further named catalyst.

copper_uranium.reasoning: Copper is at a record high and FCX is up 21% in 20 days (+16% in 5), so the good news is priced in. The uranium headlines do not reach FCX. A reversal is as likely as a continuation. No named catalyst.

would_change_my_mind: A scheduled catalyst with a clear surprise (NVDA or FCX earnings, a jobs-report shock, an Iran or Hormuz deal) that has not yet moved the stock.

handoff.what_changed: The July stress reversed: VIX fell to 15.8 and the S&P 500 and Dow hit records. Chips rebounded 13% in 5 days, gold rose 3.7% in a day, copper hit a record, WTI fell 11% on Hormuz reopening hopes, and Lilly raised guidance. All families stay flat because the moves are already priced in.

oil_gas.why: WTI -11% in 5 days on Hormuz hopes is priced in and XOM has no company-specific catalyst.

gold_miners.why: The one-day gold spike (+3.7%) and NEM +14% in 5 days are priced in, with no named cause.

chips.why: The 13% sector rebound already happened and no NVDA catalyst is dated.

pharma.why: Lilly Q2 beat and guidance raise are priced in after a +4.9% day.

copper_uranium.why: Copper at a record and FCX +21% in 20 days are priced in; uranium news does not reach FCX.

handoff.next_job: Next decision day: read the handoff, check whether the rebounds in chips, gold and copper held, and look for a dated catalyst (NVDA, FCX or XOM earnings, the jobs report, Iran or Hormuz news). Stay flat unless a named reason appears.
